user.title: Precipitation Radial Card
user.description: A PirateWeather API key is required. Register for a free key at pirate-weather.apiable.io.

data_description.api_key: Get a free key at pirate-weather.apiable.io.
data_description.latitude: Decimal degrees, e.g. 40.712 (3 decimal places is sufficient).

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key. Please check your PirateWeather API key.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the PirateWeather API. Please try again.

data_description.latitude: Decimal degrees, e.g. 40.712 (3 decimal places is sufficient).
data_description.minutely_interval: How often to fetch minutely precipitation data (default: 600s). Lower values use more API calls. Each restart also triggers a fetch.
data_description.hourly_interval: How often to fetch hourly forecast data (default: 1800s). Lower values use more API calls. Each restart also triggers a fetch.
data_description.weekly_interval: How often to fetch the 7-day hourly forecast used by the forecast drill-through page (default: 3600s).

api_quota_exceeded.title: Pirate Weather API limit reached
api_quota_exceeded.description:
Pirate Weather is rejecting requests (HTTP 429): the {limit} calls/month allowance of your API key is used up until {reset_date}. The card and forecast page will show stale data until then.

Raise the update intervals under {options_path} (currently about {calls_per_day} calls/day), or upgrade your Pirate Weather subscription.

api_quota_projected.title: Pirate Weather API limit will be reached
api_quota_projected.description:
At the current update intervals (about {calls_per_day} calls/day) this integration will make about {projected} more calls before your allowance resets on {reset_date}, but only {remaining} of {limit} remain.

Raise the intervals under {options_path} (e.g. minutely ≥ {suggest_minutely}s, hourly ≥ {suggest_hourly}s, weekly ≥ {suggest_weekly}s), or upgrade your Pirate Weather subscription.
